integrity: A complete mathematical proof and standalone exact independent finite checks are included. The theorem for every even N rests on the universal proof, not the tests.
scientific_limitations: All assertions concern general smooth complex sections and rational Betti ranks; no torsion, Hodge decomposition, or special-section assertion. The originating Fano preprint was accessible in abstract but not as complete full text for comparison. General Schubert calculus makes equivalent historical evaluations possible.
title: Rational Betti profiles of the anticanonical sections of line-Grassmannian Fano varieties
